about: Every difference between the oracle's conversion legs and Routeweft's that the pinned differential finds (internal/parity/legs_test.go, compat/parity/generate-protocol-legs.mjs), with the PARITY item that accounts for it: a D row, a register item (V12, G2, ...) or a section (§6.7). A difference not listed here fails the test; an entry that no longer matches a difference fails it too. It is the divergence ledger the sign-off report (compat/parity/ledger.mjs) summarizes.
